NEIGHBOURHOOD_MARGIN_MM.why: a room's wall lies outside its free-space region by at most the wall's thickness. 1 m covers any wall a drawing of this kind carries, with room to spare

COLLINEAR_JOIN_MM.why: two collinear pieces closer than this are one line interrupted by plotting noise. Two orders of magnitude above the measured coordinate-noise floor and above the 0.05 mm snap grid

JUNCTION_REACH_MM.why: the only tolerance that can CLOSE anything, so it is deliberately tight: a hairline plotting gap at a junction, never a missing wall or a doorway

MIN_CELL_MM.why: below this an arrangement cell is a sliver

MIN_ENCLOSURE_M2.why: below this a filled area is not a space

frozen_parameters.how_these_were_set: from geometry and from the drawing medium's measured noise floor, on synthetic fixtures, BEFORE any real drawing was evaluated. None may be changed because a real drawing scores better unless the same change is justified synthetically

frozen_before: ANY evaluation of AR-00 or any other real drawing
